package ui

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"testing"
)

func menuHitFixture(t *testing.T, maxGap float32) (*Tester, *any) {
	t.Helper()
	var got any
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		scope := Column(c).Key("scope").Selectable().Size(300, 200)
		scope.Children(func() {
			Row(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(scope, "A").Children(func() { Text(c, "paragraph").Width(40).Height(20) })
		})
		scope.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
			var ok bool
			got, ok = m.TextMenuHit(scope, maxGap)
			if ok {
				m.Item("hit")
			}
		})
	}, 400, 250)
	return tt, &got
}
func TestTextMenuHitStrictManhattanAndFinite(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name      string
		x, y, gap float32
		want      bool
	}{
		{"inside", 10, 10, 24, true}, {"near", 10, 43.999, 24, true}, {"boundary", 10, 44, 24, false}, {"outside", 10, 44.001, 24, false},
		{"diagonal", 51, 32, 24, true}, {"diagonal-boundary", 52, 32, 24, false}, {"zero", 10, 10, 0, false}, {"negative", 10, 10, -1, false},
		{"nan", 10, 10, float32(math.NaN()), false}, {"inf", 10, 10, float32(math.Inf(1)), false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			tt, got := menuHitFixture(t, tc.gap)
			tt.RightClickAt(tc.x, tc.y)
			if (*got != nil) != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("got=%v want=%v", *got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitOpeningSnapshotAndCancel(t *testing.T) {
	value := "A"
	var got any
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		scope := Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 200)
		scope.Children(func() {
			Row(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(scope, value).Children(func() { Text(c, value).Width(40).Height(20) })
		})
		scope.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
			if v, ok := m.TextMenuHit(scope, 24); ok {
				got = v
			}
			m.Item("choice")
		})
	}, 400, 250)
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if got != "A" {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
	if tt.rt.textMenuOpening != nil {
		t.Fatal("opening retained past collect")
	}
	tt.Move(280, 180)
	tt.CloseMenu()
	value = "B"
	tt.Frame()
	got = nil
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 150)
	if got != nil {
		t.Fatal("cancel then blank reused opening")
	}
	tt.CloseMenu()
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if got != "B" {
		t.Fatal("reopen not fresh", got)
	}
	_ = tt.ChooseMenuItem("choice")
	if tt.rt.textMenuOpening != nil {
		t.Fatal("chosen replay retained event")
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitOwnerAndWindow(t *testing.T) {
	var foreign Element
	b := NewTester(func(c *Context) { foreign = Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 200) }, 400, 250)
	_ = b
	owner := "a"
	got := false
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		s := Column(c).Key(owner).Selectable().Size(300, 200)
		s.Children(func() { Row(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(s, "A").Children(func() { Text(c, "A") }) })
		s.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
			if _, ok := m.TextMenuHit(foreign, 24); ok {
				t.Fatal("foreign window accepted")
			}
			_, got = m.TextMenuHit(s, 24)
			m.Item("item")
		})
	}, 400, 250)
	owner = "b"
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if got {
		t.Fatal("owner replacement accepted previous commit")
	}
	tt.Frame()
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if !got {
		t.Fatal("new current owner not accepted")
	}
	tt.rt.close()
	if tt.rt.textMenuFrames != nil || tt.rt.textMenuOpening != nil || tt.rt.textMenuTargets != nil {
		t.Fatal("window close retained tokens")
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitDefaultEmptyAndKeyboard(t *testing.T) {
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		s := Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 200)
		s.Children(func() { Text(c, "default") })
		s.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
			if _, ok := m.TextMenuHit(s, 24); ok {
				t.Fatal("unregistered scope hit")
			}
			m.Item("unchanged")
		})
	}, 400, 250)
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if len(tt.Menu()) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("default menu changed")
	}
	registered, _ := menuHitFixture(t, 24)
	registered.RightClickAt(10, 150)
	if len(registered.Menu()) != 0 || registered.rt.textMenuOpening != nil {
		t.Fatal("empty result did not consume/release")
	}
	registered.ClickAt(10, 10)
	registered.Key(0, KeyContextMenu)
	if len(registered.Menu()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("keyboard incorrectly treated as pointer origin")
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitClipDisabledOcclusionAndList(t *testing.T) {
	var list ListState
	disabled, hidden, cover := false, false, false
	var got any
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		s := Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 120).Disabled(disabled)
		if hidden {
			s.Invisible()
		}
		s.Children(func() {
			List(c, &list, 100, func(i int) {
				Row(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(s, fmt.Sprint(i)).Children(func() { Text(c, fmt.Sprintf("row %d", i)).Height(30) })
			}).Grow(1)
		})
		s.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
			if v, ok := m.TextMenuHit(s, 24); ok {
				got = v
				m.Item("hit")
			}
		})
		if cover {
			Box(c).Absolute().Left(0).Top(0).Size(300, 120).Background(RGB(0, 0, 0)).Focusable()
		}
	}, 400, 200)
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if got != "0" {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
	tt.CloseMenu()
	got = nil
	list.ScrollTo(80, Start)
	tt.Frame()
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if got == nil || got == "0" {
		t.Fatal("List eviction failed", got)
	}
	tt.CloseMenu()
	got = nil
	for _, f := range tt.rt.textMenuFrames {
		for _, b := range f.blocks {
			if b.bounds.Y < 0 || b.bounds.Y+b.bounds.H > 120 {
				t.Fatal("clip not applied", b.bounds)
			}
		}
	}
	cover = true
	tt.Frame()
	tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	if got != nil {
		t.Fatal("occluded scope hit")
	}
	cover = false
	disabled = true
	tt.Frame()
	if len(tt.rt.textMenuFrames) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("disabled scope retained tokens")
	}
	disabled = false
	hidden = true
	tt.Frame()
	if len(tt.rt.textMenuFrames) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("hidden scope retained tokens")
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitTargetLimitAndPassPruning(t *testing.T) {
	count := textMenuTargetLimit + 1
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		s := Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 200)
		s.Children(func() {
			for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
				Row(c.Key(i)).RegisterTextMenuTarget(s, i).Children(func() { Text(c, "A").Height(1) })
			}
		})
	}, 400, 250)
	if len(tt.rt.textMenuFrames) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("overflow kept partial targets")
	}
	count = 1
	tt.Frame()
	if len(tt.rt.textMenuFrames) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("normal frame did not recover")
	}
	count = 0
	tt.Frame()
	if len(tt.rt.textMenuFrames) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("removed targets retained")
	}
}

func TestTextMenuHitCollectPanicReleasesEvent(t *testing.T) {
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		s := Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 200)
		s.Children(func() { Row(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(s, "A").Children(func() { Text(c, "A").Size(40, 20) }) })
		s.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
			if _, ok := m.TextMenuHit(s, 24); ok {
				panic("fixture collection error")
			}
		})
	}, 400, 250)
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() == nil {
				t.Error("expected fixture panic")
			}
		}()
		tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	}()
	if tt.rt.textMenuOpening != nil {
		t.Fatal("panic retained opening event")
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitFinalPassRegistrationOnly(t *testing.T) {
	value := "A"
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		s := Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 200)
		s.Children(func() { Row(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(s, value).Children(func() { Text(c, value).Size(40, 20) }) })
		if Button(c, "change").Clicked() {
			value = "B"
		}
	}, 400, 250)
	if err := tt.Click("change"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if value != "B" {
		t.Fatal("button not consumed")
	}
	if len(tt.rt.textMenuFrames) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("duplicate or missing final pass")
	}
	for _, f := range tt.rt.textMenuFrames {
		for _, b := range f.blocks {
			if b.token != "B" {
				t.Fatalf("earlier pass retained %v", b.token)
			}
		}
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitWindowsReleaseOrigin(t *testing.T) {
	tt, got := menuHitFixture(t, 24)
	var scope uint64
	for id := range tt.rt.textMenuFrames {
		scope = id
	}
	// Exercise the unchanged Windows release path directly on every host.
	tt.rt.menu.release = scope
	tt.rt.pointerX = 10
	tt.rt.pointerY = 150
	if !tt.rt.menuRelease() {
		t.Fatal("release not consumed")
	}
	tt.Frame()
	if *got != nil || len(tt.Menu()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("blank release incorrectly used press/old target")
	}
	tt.rt.menu.release = scope
	tt.rt.pointerX = 10
	tt.rt.pointerY = 10
	if !tt.rt.menuRelease() {
		t.Fatal("second release not consumed")
	}
	tt.Frame()
	if *got != "A" {
		t.Fatal("valid release target missing", *got)
	}
}

func TestTextMenuHitRejectsInvalidDerivedDistance(t *testing.T) {
	for _, v := range []float32{float32(math.NaN()), float32(math.Inf(1)), float32(math.Inf(-1))} {
		tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
			s := Column(c).Selectable().Size(300, 200)
			s.Children(func() { Row(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(s, "A").Children(func() { Text(c, "A").Size(40, 20) }) })
			s.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
				if m.textHit != nil {
					m.textHit.distance = v
				}
				if _, ok := m.TextMenuHit(s, 24); ok {
					t.Errorf("accepted nonfinite derived distance %v", v)
				}
			})
		}, 400, 250)
		tt.RightClickAt(10, 10)
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitActualBlockLimit(t *testing.T) {
	count := textMenuBlockLimit
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		s := Column(c).Selectable().Size(100, 5000)
		s.Children(func() {
			Column(c).RegisterTextMenuTarget(s, "A").Children(func() {
				for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
					Text(c.Key(i), "A").Size(40, 1)
				}
			})
		})
	}, 100, 5000)
	blocks := 0
	for _, f := range tt.rt.textMenuFrames {
		blocks += len(f.blocks)
	}
	if blocks != textMenuBlockLimit {
		t.Fatalf("actual mounted block count %d", blocks)
	}
	count++
	tt.Frame()
	if len(tt.rt.textMenuFrames) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("4097 blocks kept partial frame")
	}
}

func TestTextMenuHitBoundedNearestAndStableTie(t *testing.T) {
	f := &textMenuFrame{scope: 1, frame: 1, visible: Rect{0, 0, 5000, 100}}
	// Farthest-to-nearest order previously caused 4096 full hit-chain scans.
	for i := textMenuBlockLimit; i > 0; i-- {
		f.blocks = append(f.blocks, textMenuBlock{uint64(i), Rect{float32(i), 0, 1, 20}, i})
	}
	calls := 0
	hit := func(x, y float32) []uint64 { calls++; return []uint64{1} }
	e := resolveTextMenuTarget(f, 0, 10, hit)
	if e == nil || e.token != 1 || calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("worst-order token=%v calls=%d", e, calls)
	}
	calls = 0
	e = resolveTextMenuTarget(f, 0, 10, func(x, y float32) []uint64 { calls++; return []uint64{2} })
	if e != nil || calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("occluded nearest must not choose farther: %v calls=%d", e, calls)
	}
	f.blocks = []textMenuBlock{{7, Rect{10, 0, 1, 20}, "first"}, {8, Rect{10, 0, 1, 20}, "second"}}
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		e = resolveTextMenuTarget(f, 0, 10, func(x, y float32) []uint64 { return []uint64{7, 8} })
		if e == nil || e.token != "first" {
			t.Fatal("unstable equal-distance registration order", e)
		}
	}
}
func TestTextMenuHitInvalidGeometryBeforeHitChain(t *testing.T) {
	for _, r := range []Rect{{float32(math.NaN()), 0, 10, 10}, {0, 0, float32(math.Inf(1)), 10}, {math.MaxFloat32, 0, math.MaxFloat32, 10}, {0, 0, -1, 10}} {
		f := &textMenuFrame{visible: Rect{0, 0, 100, 100}, blocks: []textMenuBlock{{1, r, "invalid"}}}
		calls := 0
		e := resolveTextMenuTarget(f, 5, 5, func(x, y float32) []uint64 { calls++; return []uint64{1} })
		if e != nil || calls != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid rect %v reached hit-chain %d / %v", r, calls, e)
		}
	}
}

func TestTextMenuHitFinitePublicTransformsCanOverflowAtCommit(t *testing.T) {
	// Both public transforms are legal. Reproduce commitElement's exact parent
	// composition without painting or allocating a giant raster.
	parent := node{transform: Scaling(1e20, 1e20)}
	child := node{transform: Scaling(1e20, 1e20)}
	world := parent.transformAt(0, 0).Mul(child.transformAt(0, 0))
	if finiteMenuNumber(world.A) && finiteMenuNumber(world.D) {
		t.Fatal("fixture did not reach derived overflow")
	}
	raw := transformRect(world, Rect{0, 0, 1, 1})
	if finiteMenuRect(raw) {
		t.Fatal("overflow geometry incorrectly finite", raw)
	}
}
